actions.label: Add reference.set from Node Library
actions.expected: The blank document creates reference.set through the canonical registry.

actions.label: Add prompt.worker from Node Library
actions.expected: The blank document creates prompt.worker through the canonical registry.

actions.label: Select Reference Set
actions.expected: The blank document exposes source controls only after the Reference Set exists.

actions.label: Link the first local reference
actions.expected: The exact local source is selected through Ether's owned native file picker.

actions.label: Link the first local reference completed
actions.expected: The owned native Open dialog returned one local image path to Ether.

actions.label: Embed the second local reference
actions.expected: The exact local source is selected through Ether's owned native file picker.

actions.label: Embed the second local reference completed
actions.expected: The owned native Open dialog returned one local image path to Ether.

actions.label: Link the third local reference
actions.expected: The exact local source is selected through Ether's owned native file picker.

actions.label: Link the third local reference completed
actions.expected: The owned native Open dialog returned one local image path to Ether.

actions.label: Select excluded Style reference
actions.expected: The Reference Desk selection carries explicit inclusion and role metadata.

actions.label: Add the excluded Style reference
actions.expected: Add updates membership explicitly and never replaces the existing source set.

actions.label: Select first reference for Replace
actions.expected: The Reference Desk selection carries explicit inclusion and role metadata.

actions.label: Select embedded Subject reference for Replace
actions.expected: The Reference Desk selection carries explicit inclusion and role metadata.

actions.label: Replace with the explicit two-reference set
actions.expected: Replace removes the unselected third reference only after the explicit action.

actions.label: Select third reference for explicit Add
actions.expected: The Reference Desk selection carries explicit inclusion and role metadata.

actions.label: Add the third reference after Replace
actions.expected: Add restores the third reference at the end of manual membership order.

actions.label: Begin Reference Set image input to Worker
actions.expected: The compatible Image input handle becomes the intended receiver.

actions.label: Complete Reference Set image input to Worker
actions.expected: The Reference Set image lane persists through ordinary canvas input.

actions.label: Open the Reference Set lane roles
actions.expected: The downstream Worker receives a deliberate semantic role, separate from member-level overrides.

actions.label: Set the Reference Set lane role to Style
actions.expected: The persisted image lane visibly carries the Style role.

actions.label: Select Worker for provider-safe preview
actions.expected: The Worker receives the enabled Reference Set image members without running a provider.

actions.label: Save the offline Worker route
actions.expected: The preview is limited to the recovery-only deterministic Worker capability.

actions.label: Preview the immutable Reference Set Worker input
actions.expected: Preview seals the currently enabled members and does not start a provider call.
